title: Material Return & Waste Feedback
short_answer: Leftover board in the rain is not a cushion — it is money.
summary: Leftover board in the rain is not a cushion — it is money.
plain_words: Leftover board in the rain is not a cushion — it is money. Count returnables before the window closes. Tell the office actual vs ordered in plain numbers. Do not invent waste factors in the manual; Job Check history and real counts are the source.
when_to_use: When the job calls for material return & waste feedback
prerequisites: Read drawings and finish schedule before acting

steps.title: Count leftover by product (standard / MR / shaft
steps.body: Count leftover by product (standard / MR / shaft / cement / steel) before it gets damaged or stolen.

steps.title: Call in returns in the supplier window the office uses
steps.body: lead or office places the pickup.

steps.title: Report actual vs ordered same week
steps.body: short note is enough (job name, product, ordered, used, returned, damaged).

steps.title: Damaged after staging: photo trail (Receiving +
steps.body: Damaged after staging: photo trail (Receiving + Protection) so it is not silently eaten as "waste."

steps.title: No published production rates in this manual
steps.body: do not invent them in the feedback note either; stick to counts.

quality_checks.prompt: Material Return & Waste Feedback: steps followed and documented

common_mistakes.title: Silent waste
common_mistakes.wrong: Throw damaged board without a note
common_mistakes.right: Photo + ticket + who owns the credit

common_mistakes.title: Return without paperwork
common_mistakes.wrong: Send material back with no PO/credit trail
